title: Sambucus nigra essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Sambucus nigra essential oil is a concentrated aromatic extract derived from the flowers of the European elderberry plant. It is commonly used in herbalism for its purported antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and immune-supporting properties. This preparation is often diluted and applied topically to treat skin conditions or used in aromatherapy to support respiratory health. It may also be used internally in very small amounts to address digestive issues, though caution is advised due to potential toxicity. Its use in herbal medicine is rooted in traditional practices, though modern scientific validation remains limited.
